source.title: Prelude in E minor, Op. 28 No. 4

patches.basis: Replace the removed quarter-beam Scheme API with the equivalent quarter-unit grouping properties; no pitch or duration changes.

Give the complete printed right-hand expression its original named Voice; the obsolete bare Voice selector otherwise consumes a property command instead of music. The containing up Staff remains in the unchanged staff expression.
Give the complete printed left-hand expression its original named Voice inside the containing down Staff, retaining cross-staff destinations and all notes.
Rename the source's custom dim. text to avoid convert-ly mistaking its uses for the obsolete built-in diminuendo music command.

patches.old: s s s s \! #(Text 0 -.8 #t) s4-\dim s  % Takt 18
patches.new: s s s s \! #(Text 0 -.8 #t) s4-\cpDimText s  % Takt 18
patches.basis: Retain the exact printed dim. markup at bar 18 under its non-colliding name.
Give the complete original playback right-hand expression its named Voice, retaining the source-defined turn realization and all playback attacks.
Give the complete original playback left-hand expression its named Voice, without changing pitches, note onsets, or durations.

ornaments.basis: The printed bar-16 A-sharp4 carries a turn with a double-sharp lower auxiliary. The original MIDIrechts explicitly realizes B4/A-sharp4/G-double-sharp4/A-sharp4 in four 64th notes. Playback must match all 604 published attacks; separately compiled printed notation must match exactly that inventory minus these four ornament attacks.

bars.description: Play the pickup, then printed bars 1–25 once; returns are written out, with no inserted repeat.

endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch search windows from cached recording analysis; final onset positions and worst-region overlays must be inspected before publication.

provenance: Source MIDI tracks were inspected against the named score staves; staff labels do not claim contrapuntal voice separation. EXT: Peters, Herrmann Scholtz, 1900b. MEAS: Correct work/movement catalogue number and original piano scoring. INFERENCE: The recording’s exact edition, repeat choices, cuts and ornaments remain unverified; do not use MIDI duration as evidence of equivalence.
Read content/listen/chopin-prelude-op28-4.mjs and cache/analysis/chopin-prelude-op28-4.txt. Editorial sections are coarse; they are not forced alignment anchors.

Compile the complete source-defined MIDIrechts/MIDIlinks playback realization, including the four bar-16 turn attacks, while engraving the unchanged printed rechts/links and turn glyph. Explicit endQ100 retains the printed three-quarter final bar rather than the playback-only six-quarter final hold.

Seven exact syntax-only repairs apply to disposable copies; immutable downloads remain unchanged. Dual multiset proof requires all 604 published playback attacks and separately proves the 600 printed attacks against that inventory minus exactly the four declared, source-pinned ornament attacks. Different wrappers do not authorize any other pitch/onset difference.
